summary: Mobile Bug: Work Orders List Not Loading on Mobile – "Failed To Load More Work Orders"
reported_issue: On mobile, opening Work Orders immediately throws 'Failed To load More Work Orders' and no work orders load.
expected_after_fix: The Work Orders list should load normally on mobile without the 'Failed To load More Work Orders' error.
steps_i_followed: Booted SPA as admin in a mobile viewport (390x844, isMobile+touch, iPhone Safari UA).
Navigated to /workorders and waited for load.
Checked the page for the 'Failed To Load More Work Orders' text and monitored /api/work-orders responses.
Scrolled to the bottom repeatedly to trigger the infinite-scroll 'load more' path.
actual_now: The Work Orders list loads normally on the mobile viewport. 30 work-order rows render on initial load with no error text, no failed API responses, and no console errors. Scrolling triggers the load-more path successfully: rows grew from 30 to 126 with five paginated /api/work-orders calls all returning HTTP 200. No 'Failed To load More Work Orders' error appears at any point.
notes: Tested via responsive/mobile viewport emulation (Chromium isMobile + iPhone UA), which matches the reported 'mobile device (browser)' environment. Both initial load and infinite-scroll pagination work with all API calls 200.
